title: Maximum Sum Circular Subarray
statement_short: Given a circular integer array nums of length n, return the maximum possible sum of a non-empty subarray. A circular array wraps around such that the end connects back to the beginning.
hint: Limit n up to 3 \* 10^4 requires an O(n) single pass, evaluating non-wrapped max and wrapped total-min sums.
why_not: Right: 1D DP computes max linear subarray sum and total - min linear subarray sum using Kadane's algorithm in O(n) time and O(1) space. Not Sliding Window: Negative elements invalidate monotonicity needed for standard sliding windows. Not Monotonic Stack: Monotonic stack tracks element bounds rather than accumulating continuous circular subarray sums. Not Greedy: Pure local choices fail to balance wrapped boundary sum subtractions correctly.
